name: Change Comprehension
description: Whether a reviewer can understand a change-set faster than by reading its raw diff
positive_state: The reviewer understands a change-set faster than by reading the raw diff
negative_state: The reviewer falls back to reading hunks file by file, or rubber-stamps the change-set

name: Claim Verifiability
description: Whether agent claims about a change-set can be checked against evidence
positive_state: Agent claims sit on anchors and can be checked against evidence
negative_state: Claims hide in a sidebar and are trusted or ignored wholesale
